presentation.paragraph1: After a rich, varied and diversified career path, I decided to specialize in the field of computer science and more particularly in web development and application design. Passionate about the world of entrepreneurship and new technologies, I continuously learn and evolve according to the required skills and market demand.
presentation.paragraph2: I design, develop and optimize web applications, from idea to realization through to production deployment. I dedicate time to self-training and constantly adapt to innovations and emerging technologies. One of my objectives is therefore to aim to exploit those that prove relevant to successfully carry out the missions entrusted to me.
presentation.paragraph3: I propose therefore digital solutions tailored to specific client needs. As a result, I wish to contribute to ambitious and transformative projects, alongside committed companies that share strong values.

myProjects.intro:
Discover my completed, recent and upcoming projects. Most of them were deployed by myself and some were done in a professional context in collaboration with other developers.

Due to confidentiality concerns, I could not provide the source code of the projects done in a company.

However, you may find some demonstration videos that I have made when the project is not immediately accessible online in order to illustrate the features and ergonomics of these projects.

context.title: Project Context
context.ecosystemQVMD:
As part of an apprenticeship within the Blue Soft Group, I work in multi-project mode following agile methodology (SCRUM type) either in TMA or in the form of 1 or 2 week sprints depending on the project.

The organizational processes are part of a DevOps approach.

Ecosystem is a public authority-approved eco-organization. Its objective is to connect professionals in order to promote the recycling and donation of all types of waste through the organization of collection.

This operation thus allows materials to be revalued by finding them a use and giving them a second life when possible.

Application development for connecting holders and service providers in the form of 2-week sprints.

 The team was composed of 4 students following this training.
